title: 野生眉做完第一个月，需要观察什么
title_en: What to observe during the first month
intro: 颜色与表面状态可能分阶段变化。下面是观察思路，不是适用于所有人的固定恢复日历。
intro_en: Colour and surface appearance may change in stages. This is a way to observe recovery, not a fixed calendar that applies to everyone.

sections.title: 刚做完的几天
sections.description: 手工野生眉前一周颜色可能偏深。按本次项目的护理说明清洁与护理，不套用其他项目的碰水、化妆或运动时间。
sections.description_en: Manual brows may look darker during the first week. Follow the aftercare instructions for your own service rather than borrowing another treatment’s schedule for washing, makeup or exercise.

sections.title: 颜色和表面变化
sections.title_en: Changes in colour and surface appearance
sections.description: 恢复期间可能出现颜色变淡、局部差异或表面代谢。不要自行抠剥；对明显不适或异常变化，及时联系老师，必要时寻求医疗评估。
sections.description_en: Fading, local variation or surface flaking may occur during recovery. Do not pick the area. Contact the practitioner about marked discomfort or unusual changes, and seek medical assessment when needed.

sections.title: 什么时候看留色
sections.description: 等恢复状态相对稳定后再评估整体留色与补色需求。所有项目一年内免费补色，复看时间根据实际状态安排。
sections.description_en: Assess overall retention and any need for a touch-up after the area has settled. All services include free touch-ups within one year; review timing depends on the actual recovery.
